pass_mark: Protocol evidence/research/reactor_triga_jsi/validation_protocol_v2.md, fixed before anything was fitted (SHA-256 of its machine-readable copy 9a0720f1822161c3b53cbc351d862ec4c077da51521ee1a96d7ceb85d8275ddc), with two amendments. The uncertainty of a comparison: the repeat scatter of one pulse within a day (peak power 1.3 percent, width 0.5 percent, energy within 50 ms of the peak 0.7 percent, energy to the scram 0.8 percent, thermocouple maximum 0.9 K) and the change for 0.03 printed dollars, the shift of the day's reference; for a row without a record also the start temperature and the scram instant, which are set by rule. On the opened pulses, in four bins of reactivity: root mean square of the error in units of the uncertainty at most 1.5 for peak power, for width and for energy to the scram; the card's range is the unbroken run of bins that hold, and outside it the card refuses. On the rows held back, for each group and each of peak power, energy within 50 ms of the peak and thermocouple maximum: root mean square at most 1.5, worst at most 3, mean at most 2 over the square root of the number of days. A straight line in printed reactivity, the nearest opened pulse, the Fuchs-Nordheim relations with the institute's constants, the unfitted model and the first card are scored beside the card; a mark that the straight line or the nearest pulse also meets is not evidence for the model.
